subject: Decision signals compact: acceptance scripts & go/no-go triggers
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Decision signals compact: acceptance scripts & go/no-go triggers

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, I attached a compact Mutual Action Plan (MAP_v1.xlsx) that focuses only on the acceptance signals we agreed would be required to close the pilot to production. High level:

- Objective: Validate Redwood inference runtime against Greenline’s 3 core success metrics (latency P95, per-token cost, and hallucination rate on clinical prompts).
- Go/no-go date: propose 2026-09-28 (see timeline in sheet)
- Owners: Greenline test leads run acceptance tests; Redwood provides test harness and test data templates

Key acceptance tests called out in the MAP:
1) Latency stability: P95 < 120ms for 512-token clinical prompt under sustained 50 RPS for 10m; test owner: Greenline QA; pass: P95 target met in 3/3 runs.
2) Cost validation: average per-token cost within 15% of estimate when using quantized model variant; pass: cost <= estimate +15%.
3) Quality safety guardrails: hallucination rate (false clinical assertions) < 2% on curated clinical-safety prompt set; pass: FPR < 2% across 5 test slices.

There are also explicit exit gates (critical blockers that would stop a go decision): data residency mismatch, unresolved SOC2 evidence, or sustained latency > 200ms in production-like workload. The MAP sheet includes an "acceptance scripts" tab — these are short cases we recommend Greenline run and record results for.

Next steps: please confirm the go/no-go date and call out any edits to thresholds. If you’re comfortable I’ll circulate a DocuSign-friendly MAP (one page) and the acceptance-tests.md with runnable steps.

Attached: [Attachment: MAP_v1.xlsx (Excel, 28 KB)]

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
[karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com]

From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@greenlinehealth.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Decision signals compact: acceptance scripts & go/no-go triggers

Karthik —

Thanks for the concise MAP. A few quick items from our side:

- Latency: can you confirm the exact hardware profile used for the benchmarks in the MAP? We need to translate P95 back to our on-prem target (A100 equivalent).
- Data residency: Greenline requires that model inference for PHI-protected prompts runs in our VPC region (us-east-2). The MAP should explicitly state which runs are VPC-based vs. hosted.
- For the hallucination metric, can Redwood provide the test harness you mentioned (so our QA can run the same measurement)?

We can target 09/28 as the go/no-go but we need the tests and a brief runbook from Redwood by 09/20. Also attaching (inline) a procurement note — we will route PO once the MAP is signed.

Subject: Re: Decision signals compact: acceptance scripts & go/no-go triggers

Sara, Karthik —

Adding the test harness and a minimal runbook here. I attached a short markdown with pragmatic, reproducible steps (acceptance-tests.md). Highlights:

Acceptance-tests.md (attached) — runnable scripts and expected outputs:
- Smoke 0 (environment): confirm VPC endpoint reachability, correct KMS keys, and sample inference request returns 200. Owner: Greenline infra. Pass: sample request returns 200 and logs stored to S3.
- Performance 1 (latency): use our loadgen script (included) to ramp to 50 RPS for 10 minutes using production-sized payloads. Measure P50/P95/P99. Owner: Greenline QA + Redwood support. Pass: P95 <= 120ms in at least 3 independent runs.
- Cost sanity: run constant small-batch inference for 1 hour with quantized model; compare actual token counts and billing estimate. Owner: Ben Carter (Redwood). Pass: measured cost <= estimate +15%.
- Safety sampling: run the curated clinical prompt set (50 prompts x 5 slices) and compute hallucination rate. Owner: Greenline clinical QA. Pass: hallucination < 2%.

Test data and scripts: attached in the acceptance-tests.md. Please note the minimum environmental pre-reqs (VPC subnet, KMS ARN, RBAC for S3 buckets). If Greenline would like, Ben can join the first test run to help capture telemetry and cost numbers.

Attached: [Attachment: acceptance-tests.md (Plain text, 12 KB)]

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
[marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com]
